title: Interleaved Speech Language Models Latently Work In Text
abstract: arXiv:2606.22473v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Speech language models (SLMs) increasingly combine speech and text, often by interleaving their tokens within a single sequence. Yet how these two modalities interact in the model's latent space remains unclear. In this work, we analyze interleaved speech--text LMs from different model families and training configurations using three complementary methods. We reveal that these models pass through an implicit latent transcription phase in which the text token matching the spoken word becomes decodable in intermediate layers, despite not being trained for speech recognition. This phenomenon occurs in diverse, natural speech, and intermediate representations also encode likely text continuations. We further show that implicit transcription emerges most when combining text-LM pretraining and speech--text interleaving, and that its prevalence is positively associated with spoken factual-knowledge retrieval. Our analysis sheds light

translated_title: 交错式语音语言模型在潜在空间中隐式处理文本
translated_abstract: 语音语言模型（SLM）日益将语音和文本结合起来，通常通过在单个序列中交错二者的词元来实现。然而，这两种模态在模型潜在空间中如何相互作用仍不清楚。在本工作中，我们使用三种互补的方法，分析了来自不同模型家族和训练配置的交错式语音-文本语言模型。我们发现，这些模型会经历一个隐式的潜在转录阶段：在该阶段中，与口语单词相对应的文本词元在中间层变得可解码，尽管这些模型并未接受过语音识别的训练。这一现象出现在多样且自然的语音中，并且中间表示还编码了可能的文本后续内容。我们进一步表明，当结合文本语言模型预训练与语音-文本交错训练时，隐式转录现象最为显著，且其普遍程度与口语事实知识检索能力呈正相关。我们的分析揭示了……
tldr: 交错式语音语言模型在中间层会隐式地将口语单词转录为对应的文本词元，且这一隐式转录现象与模型的口语事实知识检索能力呈正相关。
en_tdlr: Interleaved speech language models implicitly transcribe spoken words into matching text tokens in intermediate layers, and this implicit transcription phenomenon is positively associated with spoken factual-knowledge retrieval.
